label: end-of-episode D1 (low value, last ~10 trials)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (fixation) steps and only in the last ~10 trials of the 100-trial episode (99.4% of mass in trials 90-99, none before trial 80); every activation has the model value output in its lowest bin, which reflects few remaining rewards. Magnitude ramps up with ep_trial (ep_trial>=94 covers 93% of the top quartile vs 63% of the bottom quartile). It is roughly indifferent to previous reward, choice, state, transition, good state, and stay/switch, and never fires at GO or D2. Recorded predicate uses the model value at D1 (observed, own computation); the alternative (phase == D1) & (ep_trial >= 92) gives dev F1 0.73, mass recall 0.97. Precision ~0.69: many late-episode D1 steps stay silent, so this is an end-of-episode timer / value-drop feature whose remaining selectivity was not captured.
